_readme: Keys are read from ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES only. This file documents the
names; it is not loaded by any script and must never hold a real key.
Tiers with no key set are skipped with a note, not an error.

execution.notes: The three free tiers share ONE work queue and run concurrently. A domain that fails one is retried by a free tier that has not tried it. Only when all three fail does it reach a paid tier.

crawl4ai.needs: pip install crawl4ai && python -m playwright install chromium
crawl4ai.notes: real browser; richest extractor of the five. Detects captcha walls fast rather than hanging

scrapling.notes: TLS fingerprinting via curl_cffi; beats handshake-based blocks that stop stdlib. Browser modes OFF - they fail on Windows and crawl4ai already covers that role

apify.notes: ALWAYS batched - every run pays ~60s container startup, so per-domain runs cost 4.4x more

firecrawl.notes: strongest anti-bot of the five; the only one that beat DataDome in testing

install_order_trap: camoufox DOWNGRADES playwright, which silently breaks crawl4ai (it then looks for a different chromium build number). Install camoufox BEFORE crawl4ai, or re-run 'python -m playwright install chromium' afterwards.
